DAY 7
Lead-in · 4 min

Why is this man so fat?

Look at the photo like a detective. Find five clues in the room. Then click a cause to compare.

Clues?
🍕
What he eats
pizza, crisps, chocolate, sugary drinks – high-calorie food, big portions, snacks all day
🛋️
How he lives
sofa + TV + remote; the treadmill is a clothes hanger – almost no exercise
🧬
Things he can't choose
genes, some illnesses, some medicines, stress and poor sleep – be fair, not everything is a "choice"
💷
The world around him
cheap fast food everywhere, cars, desk jobs – in the UK and US about 1 in 4 adults is obese
Language: be overweight → be fat (informal, a bit rude) → be obese (medical). Today's text uses fat – it is a friend talking about a friend.
So what can he do? One phrase – you'll need it today.
go on a diet = start eating less / only certain foods to lose weight. He is on a diet. He broke his diet.

Teacher: 照片为 AI 生成的虚构人物，可放心讨论。先让学生找线索（pizza, crisps, soda, remote, treadmill as clothes hanger），再点开四类原因；第三类提醒学生"不是所有都是个人选择"，避免 body-shaming。最后引出 go on a diet。

The title · 2 min

A reward for virtue?

Two big words. Click each, then predict: what kind of reward does a man on a diet deserve?

reward · virtue

reward /rɪˈwɔːd/ – something good you get for doing something good
a reward for hard work · reward yourself with a day off · The police offered a reward.
virtue /ˈvɜːtʃuː/ – good behaviour, moral strength
Patience is a virtue. · Honesty, courage, self-control are virtues. Keeping a diet needs the virtue of… ? (self-control!)

Skim · 2 min

Read fast. One question.

2:00
Q · the only questionHugh has been on a diet for a week. Is it working? Find two sentences that prove your answer.
No. ① "Hugh was still as fat as ever." ② "It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!" – he is eating the forbidden foods.

一个问题，但要求两处证据：一处是外表（as fat as ever），一处是行为（包裹里的东西）。2 分钟后合上书回答。

Text X-ray · 3 min

Before we read closely: what matters here?

★ KEY STRUCTURE⚠ TRICKY◆ USEFUL PHRASE

1 · The diet

Sentences 1–4
Hugh has always been fat → decides on a diet → writes the forbidden list → the list is everything he loves.
★things got so bad that he decided…
so + adj + that-clause = result. Appears TWICE in the text. Today's grammar.
⚠has always been fat
present perfect + always = from the past until now, still true.
⚠all the foods which were forbidden
relative clause, passive inside it. forbidden = not allowed.
◆go on a diet · first of all · write out · include
Four phrases to steal for your own writing.

2 · The visit

Sentences 5–8
Narrator visits → Hugh as fat as ever → hides a parcel → obviously embarrassed.
◆pay sb a visit · as … as ever
pay a visit = visit (more formal). as fat as ever = exactly as fat as before.
⚠was not surprised to see that…
be + adj + to-infinitive + that-clause. Why NOT surprised? The narrator knows Hugh.
⚠hurriedly hid … under
adverb -ly before the verb; hide–hid–hidden. First of three -ly adverbs: hurriedly, guiltily, occasionally.
★It was obvious that…
It + be + adj + that-clause. Great sentence opener for exams.

3 · The reveal

Sentences 9–12
Asked what he was doing → smiles guiltily → "diet so strict, must reward myself" → chocolate and sweets!
⚠asked him what he was doing
indirect question: statement word order + tense moves back (are doing → was doing).
★explained that his diet was so strict that he had to…
so…that again – inside reported speech. Hugh's excuse in one sentence.
◆reward oneself · occasionally · the contents of
reward yourself (reflexive) · occasionally = sometimes, not often · contents = what is inside.
⚠five large bars of chocolate · three bags of sweets
uncountable chocolate → a bar of; sweets countable → a bag of. Why the "!"? The joke.

Teacher: 这是"先分析后精读"——用 1 页告诉学生今天看什么：★ 两处 so…that 是语法重点；⚠ 是容易读错/译错的点；◆ 是可以直接搬进作文的短语。点开即显示理由，不逐条讲，30 秒扫一遍即可。

Vocabulary

Eight phrases to take away

Say the Chinese first, then flip. Then close your eyes – your partner reads the Chinese, you say the English.

发音提示：forbidden 重音在第二音节 /fəˈbɪdn/；embarrassed 两个 r 两个 s，/ɪmˈbærəst/；occasionally /əˈkeɪʒnəli/ 含 /ʒ/（上次摩擦音课的 -sion）。

Grammar focus

"…so strict that he had to reward himself."

Cause → result. so + adjective/adverb + that + clause. With a noun: such (a) + adj + noun + that.

Result machine

Hugh wassoadjectivethatresult
so + adj / adv + thatsuch + (a) + adj + NOUN + that
so fat that… · so quickly that… · so many sweets that… / such a strict diet that… · such bad things that…
Shortcut: so/such…that → too…to / enough to (a different structure, same idea).

so or such? Click to check

Teacher: 口诀——后面是形容词/副词用 so，后面是名词（短语）用 such；so many/much/few/little + 名词仍用 so。课文两处：things got so bad that… / his diet was so strict that…

Wrap-up

Where is the virtue?

💬 Discuss (3 min)

"His diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally."
  • Reward for virtue – what is the "virtue" here? Did Hugh show any? (Irony: he rewards himself for self-control he doesn't have.)
  • Is Hugh lying, or does he believe his own excuse? Have you ever made an excuse like this?
  • Back to the photo: what ONE small change would you suggest to Hugh – and how would you say it kindly?

📝 Homework

  • Retell in 60–80 words as Hugh ("I've always been fat, but…") – keep both so…that sentences.
  • Six sentences: three with so…that, three with such…that, about your own week.
  • Write Hugh's new list for next week – five forbidden things, five allowed things, in two columns.

Exit ticket: 一句 so…that 描述今天的自己（I was so tired that…）。

Look at the picture. What do you think it means? Guess in English!
